headline: Welcome
to
*AgentStack.*
scenes.line: Hi, I'm Zack. Welcome to AgentStack, and congratulations, you're all signed up! Before we set anything up, let me show you everything you've just unlocked.

headline: Your
whole
business,
*one
place.*
scenes.line: AgentStack brings your whole real estate business together: your leads, your clients, your listings, and your marketing, all in one place, all working together.

headline: No
more
*juggling.*
scenes.line: No more jumping between your email, your texts, a spreadsheet, and five different apps. It all lives here now.

headline: Every
deal,
*in
view.*
scenes.line: Every client has one profile in People, with their notes, messages, and history together. And in Deals, every deal moves across a simple board, from new lead to closed.

headline: Every
conversation,
*one
inbox.*
scenes.line: In Conversations, your text messages, and depending on your plan, WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram messages, all land in one inbox.

headline: Answers,
*day
and
night.*
scenes.line: Your AI agent answers questions for you around the clock, in the chat on your website and by text. It collects the lead's details and hands them straight to you.

headline: Follow
up
in
*seconds.*
scenes.line: When a new lead fills in one of your forms, Follow-Up Plans send them a text and an email within about a minute, automatically, even at midnight.

data.label: A text and an email go out on their own

headline: Showings
*book
themselves.*
scenes.line: With Booking, clients pick a time that works on your calendar, and confirmations and reminders go out on their own.

headline: Listings
that
*market
themselves.*
scenes.line: Connect your listings, and AgentStack drafts the marketing for each one: a property page, social posts, an email, and a text. You approve everything before it goes out.

headline: Get
*found.*
scenes.line: Capture leads with forms on your website, build your site in Website Studio, and run local search campaigns, all from the same place.

headline: Run
the
*business
side.*
scenes.line: Send quotes and invoices your clients can pay online, and see what's working with plain-English reports in Analytics.

headline: Six
*simple
steps.*
scenes.line: Getting started takes six simple steps: your business details, your email or phone, your listings, social, payments, and your domain.

headline: I'll
*guide
you.*
scenes.line: I'll guide you through each one, a question at a time. A setup button stays at the bottom of every page, and each step only checks off when it's really done.

data.to: Next: Connect your email or phone

headline: Let's
*get
started.*
scenes.line: That's AgentStack. Your business, all in one place, working for you. Let's get started, with your business details first.
